user.title: SB Watch rule

selection.name: Which entities
selection.description: A named filter (made under SB Filter, or with New filter in the SB Watch panel and cards), OR individual entities — one of the two.

data_description.filter: Pick a named SB Filter. Every rule and card that picks it follows its edits.
data_description.entities: Exactly these entities — for a rule about one or two things.

trigger.name: When do they trigger
trigger.description: Any one row triggers the rule for that entity. No rows: every selected entity counts.

data_description.triggers: State: a word state held for the duration. Range: a numeric state inside the range for the duration (<20, 15-50, =3). Rate: change per minute/hour/day, measured over the duration.

effect.name: When the rule is in effect
effect.description: Optional. A daily time window (may cross midnight, e.g. 18:00 → 06:00) AND a set of weekdays. Outside them the rule sees nothing: no count, no notification, no action. For a window crossing midnight the day is the one it started on.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Optional: what the rule does when something becomes active.

data.act: What to do at the timeout
data.warn_ahead: Warn-ahead — act this long after notifying (notify-then-act only)
data.act_script: Script to run (when “Run a script”) — gets entity_id, entity_ids and rule as variables
data.act_actions: Actions to run (when “Run these actions”) — entity_id, entity_ids and rule are available as variables
data.notify_url: Where a tap on the notification goes (a dashboard path like /dashboard-monitor/0, or entityId:light.x; empty = the first active entity)

data_description.action: Notify replaces one notification per rule in place and clears it when nothing is active. Act calls the chosen service (turn off, turn on, toggle, a script, or your actions) on the entities that just entered. The rule's Paused switch stops both.
data_description.warn_ahead: e.g. 10m. 0 = act at once after notifying.

data.problem: Report as a problem (binary sensor device class)
data.filter_yaml: Filter as YAML — paste an SB Entity Browser card's filter

data_description.filter_yaml: What this form can express is moved into the fields and trigger rows; the rest stays here and then defines the whole filter.

error.empty_filter: The rule selects nothing — fill at least one row or add a trigger.
error.bad_yaml: The YAML does not parse, is not a mapping, or has a key that is neither a selection nor a state condition. {unmatched}
error.bad_duration: Unreadable duration — use 2h, 1h30m, 90s or a number of minutes.
error.bad_notify: A notify service looks like notify.mobile_app_phone.
error.bad_act: Choose what to do: turn off, turn on or toggle.
error.unknown_value: A state no selected entity can be in: {unmatched}
error.bad_script: Pick a script (script.…) for “Run a script”.
error.bad_actions: Add at least one action for “Run these actions”.
error.no_source: Pick a filter or some entities.
error.pick_one: Pick a filter OR entities, not both.
error.filter_missing: That filter no longer exists — pick another.
